blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — The Sinulog Foundation Inc. (SFI) has revised the official logo for the 2027 festival following public criticism over its initial depiction of the Señor Sto. Niño. The foundation unveiled the redesigned logo on Friday, November 20, after receiving comments and recommendations from Cebuanos and devotees following the release of the original design on November 6. In a statement, SFI said that the revised version incorporated suggestions from the public, acknowledging the response to the initial logo. “We have heard you. We have listened.
